name: PigeonPea.Plugins.Logging.Diagnostic
description: Routes Microsoft.Extensions.Logging entries to the diagnostic service for error tracking and system health monitoring
author: PigeonPea Team

minimumLevel.description: Minimum log level to capture (Trace, Debug, Information, Warning, Error, Critical)

includeLogLevel.description: Whether to include log level in diagnostic data

includeCategory.description: Whether to include logger category in diagnostic data

trackWarnings.description: Whether to track warnings as diagnostic events

trackErrors.description: Whether to track errors as diagnostic events

createSessions.description: Whether to create diagnostic sessions for related events

logAllCategories.description: Whether to log all categories or filter them

allowedCategories.description: List of allowed categories when LogAllCategories is false

examples.title: Basic Diagnostic Logging
examples.description: Add diagnostic logger sink with default options

examples.title: Custom Diagnostic Configuration
examples.description: Configure diagnostic logger with custom options

examples.title: Dependency Injection Setup
examples.description: Register diagnostic logger with dependency injection

notes: Provides comprehensive error and warning tracking through the diagnostic service
Supports diagnostic sessions for grouping related events
Includes health metrics monitoring and reporting
Supports both direct instance and dependency injection patterns
